messages.content: Find a picnic spot in Miami.

message.content:
Here’s a quick list of great picnic-friendly spots around Miami—each offers plenty of shade, scenic views, and easy access: | Spot | Highlights & What Makes It Great | |------|----------------------------------| | **South Pointe Park** (Miami Beach) | • Oceanfront lawns, boardwalks, and a playground.
• Great view of Fisher Island and cruise ships.
• Picnic tables available near the beach entrance. | | **Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Recreation Area** (Key Biscayne) | • Historic lighthouse, sandy beaches, and shaded pavilions.
• Large grassy areas perfect for blankets and games.
• Free parking on weekdays (paid weekends). | | **Lummus Park** (Miami Beach) | • Long stretch along Ocean Drive – ideal for sunset picnics.
• Tennis courts, volleyball nets, and a kids’ play area nearby.
• Convenient public restrooms and food kiosks. | | **Oleta River State Park** (North Miami) | • Largest urban park in FL – miles of trails, kayaking, and bike paths.
• Several designated picnic sites with grills and shelters.
• Wildlife viewing opportunities (birds, turtles). | | **Venetian Gardens** (Coral Gables) | • Elegant Mediterranean-style gardens, fountains, and benches.
• Quiet setting away from traffic, yet close to downtown amenities.
• Ideal for a relaxed lunch under canopy trees. | | **Everglades Holiday Park Picnic Pavilion** (Homestead) | • Unique Everglade backdrop, airboat tours nearby.
• Covered pavilion with seating and grill stations.
• Kids love spotting alligators up close! | ### Quick Tips: 1. **Check Weather:** Miami can get hot quickly—bring sunscreen, hats, and stay hydrated. 2. **Reserve if Needed:** Some parks allow free reservations online (especially during peak season). 3. **Leave No Trace:** Pack out everything you bring in, keep trash bins full, and respect wildlife. Enjoy your sunny day out in Miami! 🌞🍉
